derivation:
by
  simpa only [vlMoll, mollifier, abs_of_nonneg, ContDiffBump.nonneg_normed] using
    (standardMollifier (d := 3) (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) (by positivity)).integral_normed (μ := volume)
explanation: Specialize to the standard mollifier bump and volume. Nonnegativity removes the absolute value. The current proof uses integral_normed through CKN.mollifier_integral_one.
